title: Mount Sinai (Horeb)
summary: The mountain of God where Moses saw the burning bush (Exod 3:1, "Horeb") and where Israel camped and received the law (Exod 19).
coordinate_basis: OpenBible.info first-ranked identification (Jebel Musa (modern)); representative point 33.973333,28.539722 (lon,lat).

certainty.basis: OpenBible.info: "Jebel Musa (modern): 50% confidence" (page fetched 2026-10-17). OpenBible lists 14 possible identifications; Jebel Musa is only 50%. Horeb (a9bb03e) is "another name for Mount Sinai" (very high).
